name: Giant Type Mask
blurb: Bold and loud: every line's key word fills the whole frame in giant heavy type and the B-roll plays INSIDE the letters (black around them), then the word punches out to reveal the clip full-frame; small caption chunks tick along the bottom; the turn inverts to white letters on the footage; the title is the final giant word, masked over the last shot.
off_why: top 5 products to resell in winter 2024, 2026-10-24: "I don't like that text effect over MAINSTREAM ... a very weird effect, we never did this before". Footage inside giant letters on black.
